reviews.review_description: Just started but I'm digging it. Maps big, you can ride a horse and fun enemies.  don't know if multiplayer is planed.

developer_response.body:
Thanks a lot! We're really glad you're enjoying it so far. 
Yes, we're currently working on adding multiplayer to the game. Once it's finished and officially launched, we'll be increasing the game's price to reflect all the new content and features. So you're one of the lucky ones who got it early at the lower price! We hope you'll enjoy the multiplayer update when it arrives.
